items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 11:1
items.html: The matter of the two aspects into which the NHY of Atik were divided is the root of every aspect of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK of the garments of the Mochin that operates in all the Partzufim of Atzilut. For He corrected them into the aspect of the NHY above the Yesod and the aspect of the NHY below the Yesod. Meaning: in these NHY of Atik, which are the garments of the Mochin of Arich Anpin, there are nine Sefirot, for they are the aspect of the reflected lights that came out upon the female waters of Arich Anpin when it was included in the screen of the head of Atik. And just as in the Mochin that came out for the sake of Arich Anpin there are ten Sefirot of direct light, so necessarily ten Sefirot of reflected light rose from the screen in the mouth of Atik, clothing those ten Sefirot of direct light, as is known. And these ten Sefirot of reflected light are called the NHY of Atik, because they came out upon the aspect of the screen of Atik, which is the aspect of Malchut, and the inclusion of this Malchut in the three lines is called NHY, as is known. And these ten Sefirot of the NHY of Atik have their root in Bina, ZA, and Malchut: the three lines of Bina are HBD, the three lines of ZA are HGT, and the three lines of Malchut are NHY, as is known.
